text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At last, enough members have gathered to 
form a team and participate in the Aoharu 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Aoharu Cup, training levels 
increase according to your team rank. You 
want to rack up as many wins as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, we need to decide on a team name. 
How about Team <Carrots>, the one I came up with 
myself?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deciding on "Team Carrots" as the team 
name, it was filled into the race entry 
form and submitted.
